method: Binary slices of whole.txt at pages.json byte offsets, written verbatim. No decoding, no reflow, no normalization. Page separators live between slices (never inside them) and follow one exact template.
layout: raw/wiki/old-wiki/pages/<pages.json path>  (keeps the wiki/<domain>/... inner shape, parallel to raw/wiki/new-wiki/<repo>/wiki/...). Bodies byte-identical to slices; all provenance and mechanical metadata in index.jsonl, never in the files.

verification.note: To re-verify: for each index.jsonl row, sha256(file bytes) must equal body_sha256, and header + concat(body_i + separator_{i+1}) must hash to pack_sha256.

index.fields: path, file, title, title_derived_from, domain, page_type, aliases, status, importance, date_created, date_modified, sources, frontmatter_parse, byte_offset, byte_length, body_sha256, words, lines, headings[{level,text}], wikilinks[{target,label}], dates_observed[]
index.note: headings/wikilinks/dates_observed are scanned from the page prose only (the page's own YAML frontmatter block is excluded; its dates live in date_created/date_modified). dates_observed are raw strings as written (the export mixes UTC and local, padded and unpadded); no normalization is applied. title falls back frontmatter -> first H1 -> filename slug, recorded in title_derived_from.
